extraction_notes: Exact identity is printed as MMBT3904-E on the page headers and p. 1 title. The base family is printed as MMBT3904, and the device is explicitly identified as an NPN transistor. No alternate MPN was inferred. The SOT-23 pinout is pin 1 base, pin 2 emitter, pin 3 collector.

The PDF contains five examined pages and is revision Rev:2024A1. PDF metadata names an unrelated source document, so identity and revision were taken from the printed datasheet content rather than metadata.

Page 2 contains usable typical plots. Curve points are sparse approximate manual digitizations of visible plotted traces at labeled or readily observed grid positions; no points were interpolated between observations. Printed mA, mV, pF, and MHz axes were converted to SI units A, V, F, and Hz.

The static characteristic is common-emitter at Ta = 25 degC; the retained representative trace is IB = 100 uA. The hFE and IC versus VBE plots provide separate typical Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC curves at VCE = 1 V.

The VCEsat and VBEsat plots are typical curves at beta = 10 for Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC. The electrical table has one saturation row at IC = 50 mA and IB = 5 mA; both tabulated voltages are guaranteed maximums and remain separate from the typical curves.

No numeric Cobo or Cibo table entries are supplied, so the scalar capacitance fields remain null rather than promoting graph-read typical values to specifications. The page 2 Cib and Cob curves are retained with f = 1 MHz, IC = 0 or IE = 0, and Ta = 25 degC conditions.

The fT table entry is a guaranteed minimum of 300 MHz at VCE = 20 V and IC = 10 mA with measurement frequency f = 100 MHz. The page 2 fT plot is a separate typical curve. The PC versus Ta plot is thermal derating evidence, not a replacement for the p. 1 maximum rating.

Other printed bounds and conditions retained in the source include VCBO = 60 V at IC = 10 uA, IE = 0; VEBO = 6 V at IE = 10 uA, IC = 0; IC = 200 mA; PC = 200 mW; RthetaJA = 625 degC/W; Tj = 150 degC; and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. The hFE classification table gives rank O = 100-200 and rank Y = 200-300; the suffix was not assigned to either rank.

The switching table also prints td = 35 ns, tr = 35 ns, ts = 200 ns, and tf = 50 ns under the stated VCC, VBE(off), IC, and base-current conditions, but the strict bjt extraction schema has no switching fields.
